# Original TD3 reference source

`TD3.py`, `main.py`, `utils.py`, and `LICENSE` are unmodified copies from
[sfujim/TD3](https://github.com/sfujim/TD3/tree/34770ccdcb51df6f6c7d85c1ba7e40d71b940d16),
revision `34770ccdcb51df6f6c7d85c1ba7e40d71b940d16`.

The original MIT license and Scott Fujimoto copyright notice are retained in
`LICENSE`. `provenance.json` records the pinned URLs, exact byte sizes, Git blob
identifiers, and SHA256 checksums. In particular, the original CRLF line endings
in `utils.py` have not been converted.

The HTML builder verifies these files and embeds selected source excerpts and
the complete license. They are displayed as Python references beside stages of
the JavaScript simulation. The browser does not execute this Python code, and
the AUV environment is a separate implementation.

This directory contains the four reference files needed by the walkthrough;
it is not a complete runnable checkout of the upstream repository.
